title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der zweiten ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ 2026 – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police report results of the ROADPOL Speedweek speed control campaign from 3 to 9 August 2026, with 12,413 speeding violations recorded at 247 checkpoints. In 61 cases drivers exceeded the limit by more than 31 km/h.
